newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Buba's Sievert-Room for lower real long-term rates.
newsitem.headline: Buba's Sievert-Room for lower real long-term rates.

text.p: SALZBURG, Austria, Oct 25 (reuter) - Bundesbank council member Olaf Sievert said on Friday there was room for real long-term German interest rates to fall and that a drop in inflationary expectations would justify such a development.

"We would have to wish for lower long-term rates and the pre-conditions for that are not so bad," Sievert told a bankers' conference. "We need lower real interest rates and judging by future inflation expectations, I would find that justified."
Sievert said any move in German key interest rates over the next few weeks could be ruled out, but added he could not predict possible moves over the next few months.
